text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.title: Crusalis Map Settings
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Everything
Master toggle - turn off to hide all rendering while data still tracks in the background (useful for screenshare safety)
Show Nation Fills
Toggle nation territory color overlays on/off
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.n: Opacity of nation territory color fills (0 = invisible, 100 = fully opaque)
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Node Borders
Toggle resource node territory borders on/off
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.w: Override all node border colors to white
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.o: Line width of the diagonal marking captured (occupied-but-not-annexed) TERRITORIES (whole nodes), drawn in the occupier's nation color
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Node Labels
Toggle resource node text labels on/off
Show Town Labels
Toggle town name text labels on/off
Show Nation Labels
Toggle nation name labels (shown larger, at each nation's capital) on/off
Show Occupied Diagonals
Toggle the diagonal marking captured (occupied-but-not-annexed) territories, drawn in the occupier's nation color
Show Chunk Grid
Draw chunk boundary lines on the world map and minimap (any dimension). Hidden when zoomed out too far to read.
Show Icons

Draw resource icons at nodes (the same icons as map.crusalis.net), plus your own PNGs from config/aechronismapmod/icons/ (see README.txt there; your files override). Shown independently of the label toggles.
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.i: Icons keep this size on screen at every zoom.
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.r: Only show node icons and labels for nodes with this type (e.g. wheat, oil, animal farm). Empty = all. The "Cycle Resource Filter" key steps through the types.
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.a: Auto-Hide Node Borders When Zoomed Out
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.h: Hide Borders Below Zoom (px per block)
Node borders disappear when the map shows fewer pixels per block than this (world map 0.25x = 0.25). Default 0.2: still shown at 0.25x, hidden further out.
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.s: Show Chunk Borders
Draw the mod's own in-world chunk borders (works where F3+G is replaced, e.g. Lunar). Also toggled by the "Toggle Chunk Borders" key, unbound by default (Controls > Crusalis Map).
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.o: Rings of chunks drawn around yours (0 = only your chunk, 1 = the 3x3 around you)
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.c: Color of the mod's chunk borders off Crusalis, outside the Overworld, for chunks no node covers, or when relation colors are off
Width of the normal border lines, in screen pixels (1-10)
Draw the thick lines at each chunk's four corners
Width of the corner lines, in screen pixels (1-10)
Blocks between the vertical lines along each chunk edge (0 = none, 16 = corners only)
Blocks between the horizontal rings around each chunk, drawn within 32 blocks of your height (0 = none)
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.a: Color the mod's chunk borders by your relation to the node that holds the chunk: own town, own nation, ally, enemy, or neutral. Overworld on Crusalis only; chunks outside any node keep the vanilla colors.
text.autoconfig.aechronismapmod.option.c: Chunk border color for nodes held by your own town
Chunk border color for nodes held by another town in your nation
Chunk border color for nodes held by an allied nation
Chunk border color for nodes held by an enemy nation
Chunk border color for unclaimed nodes and nodes held by a nation you have no relation with
